headline: Gold price today, September 30: SJC gold and 9999 gold rise by the hour; be cautious of both buying and selling prices!
summary: Vietnamese gold prices rose sharply on September 30, 2026, with SJC gold sold out at 144.1 million dong per tael, while 9999 ring gold approached that level. Some brands raised prices by up to 1.6 million dong per tael.
why: Gold is a traditional store of value, and Vietnam's domestic gold market is largely set by SJC bars, which trade at a premium to global spot prices.
